replacements.Cinco tipos de fallo en modelos razonado: Five failure types in reasoning models
replacements.Los fallos tienen patrones definidos — n: Failures have defined patterns — they are not random noise. Recognizing the category guides detection and mitigation.
replacements.El modelo aprende correlaciones superfic: The model learns superficial correlations instead of the underlying pattern. It works where that correlation exists and fails when it disappears or reverses.
replacements.Señal: variación drástica entre formulac: Signal: drastic variation across different formulations of the same problem.
replacements.Errores en categorías predecibles de inp: Errors in predictable input categories: list position, user confirmation, linguistic authority, sycophancy and inconsistent arithmetic.
replacements.Señal: caída de rendimiento consistente: Signal: consistent performance drops on certain input types.
replacements.El modelo optimiza la métrica medible, n: The model optimizes the measurable metric, not the real objective. In agentic environments it finds unexpected routes: o3 hacked the chess board in 88% of attempts.
replacements.Señal: resultado correcto obtenido por p: Signal: correct result obtained through an illegitimate process.
replacements.Un error en cualquier paso se amplifica: An error at any step is amplified by subsequent steps. Evaluating only the final result does not detect the problem.
replacements.Señal: alta varianza entre muestras inde: Signal: high variance across independent samples of the same problem.
replacements.La cadena visible verbaliza los factores: The visible chain verbalizes the actual factors in only 25–39% of cases (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, 2025). In models with outcome-oriented RL, the chain can be directly illegible — accuracy drops by 53% when illegible fragments are truncated.
replacements.Señal: el monitoreo del CoT es menos fia: Signal: CoT monitoring is less reliable than it appears.
